verdict.rationale: Community Phone is a home and business phone service, so call and message webhooks are a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for call or message events. The only related items are in-app missed-call alerts, the app and dashboard, and voicemail-to-email, which are adjacent notifications rather than webhooks, and probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404.

support.subject: As a developer, call and message events arrive as webhooks I can wire into my own systems
